message.content: After discussing the intense and intriguing nature of "Succession," Emily Burnett recommends another show to Li Hua named "The White Lotus." Emily expresses her interest in this show, noting that it combines elements of drama and dark comedy, and she appreciates the setting of a resort with hidden agendas among the characters. She believes that "The White Lotus" could be an entertaining watch, and she encourages Li Hua to add it to his list. Emily also mentions that she is planning to start watching "The White Lotus" herself next.
